name: Fired Up! buff text states the 30% crit its DBC variable omits (#7688)
contract: Fired Up! 704823 is granted by CharacterAdvancement entry 33877 in the
Incineration tab, but its SkillLineAbility.dbc row 90281 points at SkillLine
86 (Flameweaving), so the client files it under the wrong spellbook tab.
The fix publishes that row with SkillLine 85 (Incineration), streamed as
SMSG_PATCH_SKILL_LINE_ABILITY, which the gameplay observer does not parse,
so no scenario step can assert the tab move itself.
The same report notes the buff never mentions its 30% critical strike chance
even though Effect[2] grants a fixed 29 (shown as 30%) that nothing rescales.
The DBC text carries that line as a bare $s3% variable, which does not
render on the buff. The fix publishes the unchanged DBC text with 30%
stated outright in coa_client_spell_description, streamed as SMSG_PATCH_SPELL
(opcode 2346) at login, following the buff-text pattern Fire and Brimstone
707480 uses. This scenario reads the streamed row and proves the working
$h% and $d parts are preserved: row 500639 (Runeshroud, published by the
same table) is the control for the stream.

steps.label: Let spawn AI, level scaling and the login patch stream settle
CONTROL: the shared description table still streams Runeshroud's own text as row 500639
STREAM: Fired Up! (704823) reaches the client stating its 30% critical strike chance
STREAM: the unrendered $s3 variable is gone from that row
STREAM: the working refund-chance part of the same row is preserved
STREAM: the buff-voiced tooltip row carries the same 40% refund and 30% crit facts
steps.text: have a 40% chance to refund their cost and increase your chance to critically strike by 30%
